en_title: Taika Waititi Says His Star Wars Movie Is 'on Ice'
cn_title: 维迪提确认《星球大战》电影搁置
subtitle: 冰河期也会结束
opus_summary: 塔伊加·维迪提确认，筹备多年的《星球大战》电影已搁置，他正与编剧Tony McNamara合作另一部作品。他还有约四部电影想拍，但未排除该项目未来重启的可能。

paragraphs.en: Director Taika Waititi has confirmed his long-in-development Star Wars movie is officially "on ice."
paragraphs.cn: 导演塔伊加·维迪提确认，他筹备多年的《星球大战》电影已正式「搁置」。

paragraphs.en: The Thor: Ragnarok and Jojo Rabbit filmmaker provided Inverse with the update when speaking to the outlet during a press junket for his new film, Klara and the Sun . When asked directly for the state of his and writer Tony McNamara's progress in the Star Wars universe, Waititi had a blunt answer.
paragraphs.cn: 这位执导过《雷神3：诸神黄昏》和《乔乔的异想世界》的导演，在新片《克拉拉与太阳》的媒体宣传活动上向Inverse透露了这一消息。当被直接问及他与编剧Tony McNamara合作的《星球大战》项目进展如何时，维迪提给出了直截了当的回答。

paragraphs.en: "I hate to break this to you, but we're going to actually put it on ice and we're working on a different thing together," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「很遗憾要告诉你，但我们确实打算把它搁置，现在我们正在合作另一个项目。」

paragraphs.en: Brutal. Rumors that Disney and Lucasfilm had approached the What We Do in the Shadows filmmaker to helm a Star Wars project go as far back as January 2020. That's just a few years after he took off as the mastermind behind one of the most beloved Marvel Cinematic Universe movies to date, with an official announcement confirming he was attached to a movie arriving just a few months later.
paragraphs.cn: 真够狠的。早在2020年1月，就有传闻称迪士尼和卢卡斯影业已接洽这位《吸血鬼生活》的导演，希望由他执导一部《星球大战》作品。彼时，他凭借执导漫威电影宇宙迄今最受欢迎的电影之一而声名鹊起，也才过去几年。传闻出现几个月后，官方便宣布他将参与一部《星球大战》电影。

paragraphs.en: It was mostly good news at first. In 2021, Waititi said he had finished his Star Wars movie's story , and in 2022, then-Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy said the goal was to bring it to theaters in late 2023 . At the time, she also admitted that Disney hadn't "locked anything in" quite yet, a fact that only became more apparent in the years that followed.
paragraphs.cn: 起初传来的大多是好消息。2021年，维迪提表示已经完成这部《星球大战》电影的故事。2022年，时任卢卡斯影业总裁凯瑟琳·肯尼迪表示，目标是在2023年底将影片搬上大银幕。不过，她当时也承认，迪士尼尚未「敲定任何事情」，而随后的几年只让这一点愈发明显。

paragraphs.en: Waititi was said to be "still working away" on the project on the third anniversary of its announcement in April 2023. After admitting he planned to prioritize other projects later that year, updates went mostly quiet. Waititi finally returned earlier this year to promise that his Star Wars movie was going to "harness a little bit more of the fun from the original trilogy." Now, it's all on ice.
paragraphs.cn: 2023年4月，项目官宣三周年之际，维迪提据称「仍在埋头推进」这部电影。同年晚些时候，他承认打算优先处理其他项目，此后便鲜有新消息。今年早些时候，维迪提终于再次谈起这部《星球大战》电影，承诺影片会「多汲取一些原版三部曲的趣味」。如今，这一切都已搁置。

paragraphs.en: "Well, there's your answer," he continued during his conversation with Inverse. "I don't even know how to dress it up or make it even vague. It's very iced. I've got about four other movies I'm trying to do."
paragraphs.cn: 他在与Inverse的对话中继续说道：「好吧，答案就是这样。我甚至不知道该怎么粉饰，或者说得含糊一点。它确实被彻底冰封了。我还有大约四部别的电影想拍。」

paragraphs.en: It's years of updates that led to what will no doubt arrive as a disappointing announcement for many, even if it's not too surprising. Going on six years with little more than the occasional minor promise never spelled a bright future for Waititi's Star Wars. When Kennedy said she thought the project was "still somewhat alive" amid her Lucasfilm exit , fans started to expect the worst.
paragraphs.cn: 多年来的进展消息，最终换来了这个无疑会让许多人失望的公告，尽管结果并不太令人意外。将近六年过去，除了偶尔给出一点承诺，项目几乎再无进展，维迪提这部《星球大战》电影的前景从来都不算光明。肯尼迪在离开卢卡斯影业之际表示，她认为这个项目「多少还算活着」，粉丝们便开始做最坏的打算。

paragraphs.en: None of this is to say Waititi hasn't stayed busy in the years between. In 2022, he launched Thor: Love and Thunder , with his Next Goal Wins movie then following the next year. Klara and the Sun will bring Jenna Ortega, Amy Adams, Steve Buscemi, and the rest of its all-star cast to theaters October 23, 2026, even if negative reviews have cast shade on its premiere. Early reception has landed it with a painful 23% on Rotten Tomatoes after 12 reviews so far.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这并不是说维迪提这些年闲着没事做。他执导的《雷神4：爱与雷霆》于2022年上映，《下一球成名》则在次年推出。《克拉拉与太阳》由珍娜·奥尔特加、艾米·亚当斯、史蒂夫·布西密等明星出演，将于2026年10月23日登陆影院，尽管负面评价已为影片首映蒙上阴影。截至目前，影片在烂番茄收获了12篇影评，新鲜度仅为令人难堪的23%。

paragraphs.en: For now, it's unclear if his Star Wars movie will ever come to be. Even he sounded a bit unsure of what the future holds, adding, "Ice ages do come to an end. Who knows?"
paragraphs.cn: 目前，他的《星球大战》电影最终能否问世，仍是未知数。就连他本人谈起未来时，听起来也有些拿不准。他补充道：「冰河期总有结束的时候。谁知道呢？」
